display_long_description:
CuriosityXR brings an AI tutor into your room. You speak. It shows and explains. You learn by touching and moving 3D models.

Some of the unlimited topics you can try:
- Human heart with labels and pathways
- Solar system with planets you can grab
- Volcano and plate tectonics
- DNA, cell, mitosis, proteins
- World maps and landforms

HOW IT WORKS
Speak your question in plain language. The AI teacher answers out loud and places a matching model in front of you. Grab it, scale it, take it apart with hand tracking or Touch controllers. Ask a follow up. Each answer builds on the last.

WHO IT IS FOR
Homeschooling families, including parents of neurodivergent and autistic learners. Teachers who want a demonstration students can walk around. Students who want fast, visual help with a science topic.

RESEARCH BACKED
CuriosityXR is research backed. Our work on context aware mixed reality learning is published by IEEE.

WORKS ON
Meta Quest 3, Quest 3S, Quest 2, and Quest Pro. Hand tracking and Touch controllers. Color passthrough on Quest 3 and 3S puts models in your real room.

One time purchase. No subscription.
